sql_templates.description: Retrieve index returns over the last 3 months.

SELECT trade_date, index_symbol, close, change_pct 
FROM market.index_eod 
WHERE trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' 
AND trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM market.index_eod) 
ORDER BY trade_date DESC;

sql_templates.description: Identify Stage 2 leadership changes over the last 3 months.
sql_templates.query:
SELECT snapshot_date, sector, COUNT(*) AS count_stage2 
FROM scores.stage_snapshots 
WHERE stage = 'STAGE_2' 
AND snapshot_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' 
GROUP BY snapshot_date, sector 
ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC;
